definition: The process of purifying a liquid, or separating a mixture, by heating it to vapour and then condensing it back to liquid form.
origin: From Latin distillare (to drip down), from de- (down) + stillare (to drip). Ancient alchemists used the technique to extract essences, giving the word its long association with refinement.
